description: 'Guidelines for preventing information leaks by keeping internal task names, IDs, and documents private in public channels'
applyTo: '**'

# Information Leaking Prevention

Do not mention internal task names, internal task IDs, or internal documents (plan files) in any public channels including:
- GitHub issues
- Pull requests
- Discussions

Keep internal project references private and use generic descriptions when communicating publicly.
